recurring_harms: injury from missed or unsafe advice;over-reliance on an AI output;privacy loss from health data
human_in_loop_decisions: Clinical escalation and any release or material model change require a clinician or clinical-safety reviewer with source evidence time to review and authority to override or pause
strongest_guardrails: Local validation before trusting AI output;hard red-flag or low-confidence stop rule;authoritative manual fallback;logged overrides and incident-triggered pause
cross_industry_pattern: Across the three healthcare product contexts the roadmap must gate scale-up on local safety evidence and an operational human fallback because a wrong or silent AI output can influence clinical action; limitation: all available group submissions are healthcare-assistant use cases so this is a cross-use-case finding not evidence for generalization across industries.
